description: This file implements the TestFrameSequence class for constructing and serializing HTTP/2 frames for testing purposes, including methods for creating various frame types such as headers, data, settings, and control frames.

classes.name: TestFrameSequence
classes.description: A class for constructing a sequence of HTTP/2 frames for testing, with methods to add different frame types and serialize the sequence.

methods.name: ToHeaders
methods.description: Converts a span of header name-value pairs into a vector of Header objects.

methods.name: ClientPreface
methods.description: Adds the client preface and settings to the frame sequence.

methods.name: ServerPreface
methods.description: Adds the server preface and settings to the frame sequence.

methods.name: Data
methods.description: Adds a DATA frame to the sequence with specified stream ID, payload, fin flag, and optional padding.

methods.name: RstStream
methods.description: Adds a RST_STREAM frame with specified stream ID and error code.

methods.name: Settings
methods.description: Adds a SETTINGS frame with specified settings.

methods.name: SettingsAck
methods.description: Adds a SETTINGS frame with ACK flag set.

methods.name: PushPromise
methods.description: Adds a PUSH_PROMISE frame with specified stream IDs and headers.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Adds a PING frame with specified ID.

methods.name: PingAck
methods.description: Adds a PING frame with ACK flag set.

methods.name: GoAway
methods.description: Adds a GOAWAY frame with last good stream ID, error code, and payload.

methods.name: Headers
methods.description: Adds HEADERS frames, with support for continuation frames if specified.

methods.name: WindowUpdate
methods.description: Adds a WINDOW_UPDATE frame with specified stream ID and delta.

methods.name: Priority
methods.description: Adds a PRIORITY frame with specified stream ID, parent stream ID, weight, and exclusivity.

methods.name: Metadata
methods.description: Adds METADATA frames, possibly split into multiple frames.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the entire sequence of frames into a string, including preface if present.
